results.content: More recently, the latest improvements to the SBM model have enabled a more scientific evaluation of CEE, thereby promoting the low-carbon development of the construction industry (Zhou et al., 2019 Investigating interior driving factors and cross-industrial linkages of carbon emission efficiency in China’s construction industry: based on Super-SBM DEA and GVAR model. TFCEE is defined as the maximum economic output achieved by the construction industry with the minimum carbon emission output through the production process of gradually increasing inputs and outputs (Cheng et al., 2018 Total-factor carbon emission efficiency of China’s provincial industrial sector and its dynamic evolution. The CEECI varies between cities due to factors such as building energy efficiency, the stage of construction industry development, building materials and technology, and building scale and density (Wang et al., 2020 Spatio-temporal evolution and trend prediction of urban carbon emission performance in China based on super-efficiency SBM model.
